captions: Quiet your heart, and bring every weary burden and healing need before the Lord today.
Isaiah 53:4-5 declares: Surely He has borne our griefs and carried our sorrows; yet we esteemed Him stricken, smitten by God, and afflicted.
But He was wounded for our transgressions, He was bruised for our iniquities; the chastisement for our peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.
Heavenly Father, we release every pain, fear, and weakness into Your gentle hands.
Let Your living waters overflow this quiet moment, restoring what is broken and refreshing every heavy soul.
Fill this space with Your divine peace.
Subscribe to rest in God's healing presence each day.
